Class OrderMapper

java.lang.Object
com.andreibel.server.utils.OrderMapper
public class OrderMapper extends Object

Order mapper class.

this class is used to map between the Order entity and the OrderRequest and OrderResponse DTOs. also make result sets from the database to Order entities.
